attempts.exactPrompt:
Create one original Summonlab candidate summon portrait as a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing. Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Pera Coren: 37-year-old woman, 164 cm (medium), clearly muscular construction with readable shoulders, back, legs, and forearms, skin value band-5-medium-deep. Face: broad oval face; full cheeks and sharply defined brows; small upturned nose, heavy lower lip; subtle age lines. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: violet-plum-pink, long-loose, deliberate accent: strong split-length construction. Wardrobe: draped-robe, specifically a draped robe whose belting and openings keep the body construction legible; a high soft collar and uneven layered hems; bounded palette lilac-smoke. Visible personal details: a compact finger-line tattoo family; a repaired cuff with bright thread. Make stitching, quilting, embroidery, or woven pattern the primary recognition device. Maintenance cue: deliberately tousled but clean. Color treatment: keeps color restrained to layered edges. Pose cue: one shoulder leads subtly and the gaze meets the viewer without a smile. Include a clay tea token only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.

This is ordinary but intentionally designed 1-star mortal clothing. No weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, or glow. No affinity cue, elemental gem, floating, frame, printed star, number, UI, logo, watermark, text, extra person, duplicated anatomy, cropped extremity, or published-character resemblance. Fantasy hair colors are matte dye or pigment, never supernatural emission. Preserve plausible anatomy while allowing the declared body construction to be extreme. Do not copy the reference's person, braid, clothes, pose, palette, progression, identity, body, hair, garments, ornaments, or markings.

RESERVE ACTIVATION: This is a fresh base summon, not an edit or regeneration of any existing hero. Create the new identity described above using only the authorized rendering-style reference. Honor the complete activated physical manifest and reserve character kernel; no failed hero or failed candidate is a visual source.

findings.observation: Exactly one coherent 37-year-old adult woman appears with one head, two natural arms and hands, two legs, and no duplicated anatomy or extra subject.
Original-resolution inspection confirms the full head and hair, both hands, the clay tea token, layered robe hems, both legs, and both boots remain entirely inside generous margins.

Visible brush planes, controlled illustrative facial and textile detail, matte plum hair, parchment wash, and soft grounding shadow maintain the cinematic semi-realistic painted register without photographic, plastic-3D, or cel-anime treatment.

The medium-height clearly muscular body, medium-deep skin, broad oval face, full cheeks, sharp brows, small upturned nose, heavy lower lip, age lines, violet-plum split-length long hair, lilac-smoke draped robe, high collar, uneven hems, bright-thread cuff repair, woven borders, and clay tea token are legible. However, tattoos extend broadly across the backs of both hands and a wrist rather than staying a compact finger-line family, while undeclared earrings and neck jewelry exceed the frozen two-anchor detail manifest.
The heavy lower lip and mouth remain closed and unsmiling, with a direct steady gaze and restrained neutral intensity rather than a grin or theatrical expression.

The worn mended robe, clay tea token, and practical boots remain ordinary mortal presentation with no weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, glow, affinity cue, frame, printed star, number, UI, logo, watermark, or text.

Pera’s broad full-cheeked face, loose tousled plum hair, muscular build, lilac draped robe, clay object, and subtly leading shoulder are distinct from the rendering reference’s angular face, long black braid, ochre progression outfit, anatomy, and pose.

attempts.retryReason: A new target version should confine the tattoo family to compact small finger lines with no back-of-hand, wrist, or forearm extension and remove undeclared earrings and neck jewelry, while preserving every passing adult identity, muscular body, hair, robe, cuff repair, clay token, framing, expression, painted-register, and one-star trait.
